title: Minimize Max Distance to Gas Station
description:
You are given an integer array `stations` that represents the positions of the gas stations on the **x-axis**. You are also given an integer `k`.

You should add `k` new gas stations. You can add the stations anywhere on the **x-axis**, and not necessarily on an integer position.

Let `penalty()` be the maximum distance between **adjacent** gas stations after adding the `k` new stations.

Return *the smallest possible value of* `penalty()`. Answers within `10^-6` of the actual answer will be accepted.
constraints: stations is sorted in a strictly increasing order.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Minimize Max Distance to Gas Station.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
